description: Starts a mobile device simulation. In VS Code/Cursor/Windsurf/Antigravity: opens in IDE. In terminal/Codex/Claude (non-extension): Free users get CLI command, Pro/Enterprise users get interactive widget. IMPORTANT: Some high-end devices and advanced network profiles require a Pro plan. Use 'list_devices' to check availability for the current user before suggesting a specific device. Only set screenshot=true if the user EXPLICITLY requests a screenshot (e.g., 'take a screenshot').

browser.description: The browser engine to emulate. Default is 'safari' for iOS and 'chrome' for Android.

device.description: The device ID (e.g. iphone-15-pro-max, pixel-8-pro). Default is iphone-15-pro-max.

network.description: The network profile ID (e.g., no-throttle, 3g, 4g, 5g). Default is 'no-throttle'.

orientation.description: The initial orientation of the device. Default is 'portrait'.

screenshot.description: ONLY set to true if the user EXPLICITLY requests a screenshot. Default is false. The simulation itself provides a live visual preview, so screenshots are only needed when specifically requested.

screenshot_type.description: The type of screenshot to capture. Default is 'SITE' (viewport).

name: simulate
title: Emuluxe Simulation
